headline: Nevish Rekindles as Berm and Passage Endure
war_summary: Since the 03:15 edition the Nevish Line has rekindled with two changes in two hours and four in six, totaling twenty-one on the day, now standing four Warden, three Colonial and one unheld about Blackcoat Way, Blinding Stones and Grief Mother to the hour of filing, on two-hour losses of 233 Colonial and 211 Warden. Palantine Berm remains busy with three changes in two hours, thirteen in six and thirty-two on the day, holding six Warden to one Colonial about The Pippeli Stones, Leiri Hermanni and Windburn Landing, last heard at 04:45. Callahan's Passage shows three changes in two hours and eleven in six, twenty-two on the day, now nine Warden to one Colonial about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage to the hour of filing, with daily losses above fifteen thousand a side. Mooring County adds one change in two hours about The Wind Hills. Stlican Shelf, Kuura Strand and the Weathered Expanse record no changes in two hours despite twenty-three, fourteen and thirty-two on the day, the Shelf still divided, Kuura Strand fully Warden-held, and the Expanse quiet since the previous evening.
